question: What is the 4‑antenatal‑checkup (ANC4) coverage by district for the selected year, and how does it compare across districts?

view.title: ANC4 Coverage by District
view.note: ANC4 coverage is the percentage of registered pregnancies that completed at least four antenatal check‑ups. It is calculated as (anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered) × 100.

interpretation_guard.caveat: The data are synthetic and may not reflect real-world values.
